About us 

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1100+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor .

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer? 

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus . You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

- Understand and frame user and product problems , using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

- Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad , from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

- Investigate and resolve complex production issues , using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

- Design and evolve robust solutions , identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

- Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack , while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

- Improve engineering practices across the organization , through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

- Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers , sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

- Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed , proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

- Contribute to the Pennylane tech community , through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you… 

- Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

- Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

- Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

- Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

- Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

🎁 What we offer 

- 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

- 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 30 vacations days paid by Pennylane

- 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

- 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

- 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

- ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

- 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

- 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

- 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

- If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 13 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

- We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. 

🤝Hiring process 

- You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

- You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our software engineers (1 hour)

- You’ll have a last culture-fit discussion with two people from our tech leadership (1 h)

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total. 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles 

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : 
Notre data policy 

🇬🇧 Personal Data 

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten 

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 

🇪🇸 Datos personales 

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: Head of People Partnering & Development
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Accompagne la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble les HRBPs et le People Development 

Pennylane est une scale-up fintech de 1 200 collaborateurs , présente en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Dans un contexte de forte croissance, d’expansion européenne et de transformation des métiers par l’IA, nous recrutons notre futur·e Head of People Partnering & Development .

Rattaché·e à la VP People, tu travailleras au plus près du COMEX et des leaders de l’entreprise.

Ta mission 

Ta mission sera d’ accompagner la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble deux disciplines complémentaires :

- les HRBPs , qui accompagnent les équipes, les managers et les organisations au plus près des enjeux business ;

- le People Development , qui porte le développement des compétences, la performance, les career paths, la gestion des talents et les programmes managers.

Tu veilleras à connecter ces expertises afin de proposer une approche People cohérente, internationale et directement alignée avec les priorités business.

Tes principales responsabilités 

Stratégie People et accompagnement du business 

- Construire et piloter la roadmap commune HRBP et People Development ;

- accompagner les enjeux organisationnels liés à la croissance et à l’internationalisation ;

- conseiller et challenger les leaders sur leurs enjeux d’organisation, de management et de talents ;

- développer une approche People fondée sur la donnée et l’anticipation ;

- suivre les indicateurs clés : turnover, engagement, performance, capacité organisationnelle et développement des compétences.

Coordination internationale 

- Garantir une approche cohérente entre la France, l’Allemagne et l’Espagne ;

- coordonner les sujets cross-country : mobilité, career paths, performance et pratiques managériales ;

- trouver le bon équilibre entre harmonisation internationale et spécificités locales ;

- contribuer à la construction d’une culture commune.

Management et collaboration des équipes 

- Manager et développer une équipe d’environ 11 personnes sur les pôles HRBP et People Development ;

- créer les conditions d’une collaboration efficace entre les deux disciplines ;

- clarifier les rôles, les responsabilités et les modes de fonctionnement ;

- renforcer la posture stratégique et l’influence de l’équipe auprès des leaders ;

- développer les compétences de l’équipe sur la data, le change et l’IA.

Talents, performance et développement 

- Piloter la stratégie Learning & Development ;

- structurer les cycles de performance et les calibrations ;

- développer les career paths, le job grading et le levelling ;

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here .

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work. 

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

Responsibilities

- Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

- Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

- Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

- Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

- Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

- Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

- Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

- Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

Must Have Experience & Skills

- 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

- Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

- Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

- Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

- Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

- Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

- Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

- Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

- Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

- Team-first mindset, low ego.

Nice to Have

- Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

- Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

- Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

What You Will Do 

- Team Leadership & Strategy: Take over, structure, and give a clear mandate to our existing team of four engineers, while building the case and the roadmap to scale the module to around eight by mid-2027.
Scenario & Simulation Engineering: Drive the design of a versioned scenario library covering nominal, edge, off-nominal, and contested flight conditions, expanding into Monte Carlo and multi-agent testing, and bring a team with no prior simulation experience up that curve.

- Execution Strategy & Gating: Establish what tests run across SITL, HITL, and CI, defining gating policies, telemetry capture, deterministic replay, and coverage analytics.

- Interface & Boundary Ownership: Negotiate, then maintain, strong, written technical boundaries with Tooling (who provide the simulation platform) and co-ownership splits with Validation (who define acceptance criteria and own final sign-off).

- Sim-to-Real Correlation: Correlate simulation models against real flight data to continuously measure and close the sim-to-real gap, ensuring green test gates reflect real-world flight readiness.

- Experience: 8+ years in automated testing, simulation-based validation, or test engineering for complex physical / hardware-in-the-loop systems (e.g., Autonomous Driving, Aerospace, Defense, Robotics).
Scenario & Simulation Depth: Hands-on experience designing scenario-based test suites on a simulation platform and defining coverage that genuinely catches defects. This is the capability our current team lacks, and therefore the most valuable thing you can bring.

- Technical Depth: Hands-on proficiency in Python, C++, Linux, Docker, and CI environments, with deep domain expertise in scenario design, SITL/HITL execution, and simulation tools.

- Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to step into an existing engineering team, establish immediate clarity, and manage distributed engineers (Paris and Lausanne) effectively**, including engineers more senior than you in years of experience**.

- Validation Mindset: A rigorous, analytical approach to noisy physical metrics, false positives, and flaky test environments, instinctively questioning what a passing test proves.

- Cross-Functional Diplomacy: Track record of defining and holding clear interfaces with platform providers and internal customer teams.
Bonus: Background in defense/aerospace flight software, control systems, or experience closing sim-to-real fidelity gaps.

- Location & Travel: Based in Paris or Lausanne, with travel between sites. Working-
level English.

- Immediate Impact: Take over an established mandate with an existing team and pre-built simulation platform, delivering test capability in weeks rather than building from scratch.

- High System Scope: Own the entire scenario library and execution strategy across our autonomy stack.
Direct Mission Impact: Build test pipelines that directly accelerate the deployment of resilient autonomous systems in real-world defense environments.
Cross-Functional Ownership: Work closely with Tooling, Validation, GNC, Perception, and Embedded SW teams to shape the future of flight-software reliability.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Job Title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager 

Type: Full-time 

Location: Paris 

What about us? 

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. 

At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. 

By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. 

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 

The Role 

We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.

As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.

The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.

If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.

What do we want to achieve together? 

First chapter — land it (through the migration) 

- 
Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.

- 
Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme ownership — you hold the plan, not someone else's.

- 
Lead through the group's regional supervisors. Your closest allies on the ground are the group's regional supervisors — their people, not ours, covering each part of the network. You set the plan, the cadence and the standards with them, and you make the programme theirs to succeed at, in an organisation where nobody reports to you. On our side, you can draw on INFINIT's Operations Agents for setup, configuration and data work.

- 
Run the product feedback loop. You are the single channel between the group and our Product & Engineering teams. You separate a genuine platform gap from a habit dressed up as a requirement, write requirements engineers can act on, and hold a prioritised backlog the customer recognises as theirs.

- 
Protect the date without breaking trust. Hundreds of agencies migrate inside a single quarter with a hard cut-over. You are the one who sees the risk early, says so, and gets it fixed.

Second chapter — grow it (the long game) 

- 
Drive adoption and value, agency by agency. You track usage across the network, spot the sites that are behind, understand why, and fix it. You know which agencies love us and which ones are quietly not using us — and you never learn that from a dashboard alone.

- 
Be the group's business partner, not their vendor contact. You understand their stock turn, their margin per vehicle, their lead conversion. You bring them insight they don't have, and you are credible with agency managers, with the DSI and with general management alike.

- 
Own the commercial outcome. Retention and renewal of our largest contract, plus the expansion of INFINIT across the group — above all the deployment of our AI agents into their day-to-day operations.

- 
Turn one account into a model. What you learn becomes INFINIT's enterprise dealer-group playbook.

What do you need to be successful in this role? 

- 
5+ years in enterprise account management in B2B SaaS , owning a small number of large, complex, multi-site customers — not a broad portfolio. You have carried retention and growth on an account that mattered to your company.

- 
You have run a multi-site deployment, not inherited one post-go-live. A rollout you personally planned and delivered: the sequencing, the readiness criteria, the training plan, the tracker, the escalation path. We will want the detail — how many sites, what broke, how you held the date.

- 
You can lead people who don't report to you. The group's regional supervisors and site managers on one side; INFINIT's Operations Agents, Product and Support teams on the other. You set direction through clarity and credibility rather than authority.

- 
Genuinely hands-on. You are comfortable being the most operational person in the room, doing training sessions yourself, sitting with end users for a full day, and being reachable when a site has a problem.

- 
Credible in two very different rooms. A technical and contractual conversation with a group IT director, and a full day in a dealership with a used-vehicle manager who has no interest in software. Neither is a performance for you.

- 
Product instinct. You are genuinely interested in how the product works, you can arbitrate configuration versus build, and you are comfortable telling a customer no and explaining why.

- 
Native-level French and fluent English. A further European language is a strong advantage.

- 
Willingness to be in the field. Expect roughly one to two days a week travelling across France during the migration phases, plus regular travel to the group's other European markets, and continued field presence afterwards.

- 
Automotive retail experience is a real plus — used vehicles, DMS, stock, pricing, listings, leads — but curiosity for it is the non-negotiable part. You will spend a lot of time on the subject of used cars.

What will you find working at INFINIT? 

- Competitive Salary and Equity : We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.

- Diverse and Inclusive Team : Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.

- Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.

- Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance.

- Corporate Gym Discount 

- Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.

- Personal Time Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.

- Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 from home

Diversity and Inclusion 

INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

description:

The Consulting Engineer's (CE) primary role is to partner within Sales and other departments to achieve sales and revenue goals, serving as technical authority and escalation resource for complex opportunities. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams, as well as industry partners, to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for enterprise environments.

Education and certifications

What it means to be a Jamf?

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

- Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
- Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
- Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
- Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
- Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1. Application with a few short questions

2. Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3. 20-minute interview

4. Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5. 45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6. Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements 

• A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

• Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

• Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

• Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

• Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

• Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

• Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits 

What We Offer

• €1,250 - €1,750 per month, depending on experience.

• A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

• Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

- Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere. 

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

You will grow at Langfuse by 

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

description:
About Dataleap 
We're the agentic operating system for the enterprise. We enable business teams to build, scale, and manage the most capable AI employees on the market.

We raised $3M from YC and angels like Aravind (CEO Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). We have thousands of agents running at 2,000+ person scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle.

I'm Sacha, Chief of Staff at Dataleap. I own our existing customers, and I need someone alongside me to make our current accounts win with Dataleap.

When a customer succeeds, it's because you made it happen.

As we scale, this role has a real path to grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap, more ownership, bigger accounts, deeper work. This is your chance to show what you've got, and I'll make sure it's the fastest growth of your career.

What you'll own 

- Customer adoption. Drive real usage inside our existing accounts. Find the champions, enable them, and help them pay it forward across their org.

- Building agents alongside customers. Sit with their teams, understand the messy details of their work, and build agents in Dataleap that solve real problems. You prove the value by shipping it.

- Being the trusted partner. Become the person our customers love to have in the room, the one who gets their world, makes them better, and makes them feel taken care of.

- Training and enablement. Run workshops, hackathons, and hands-on sessions that turn non-technical teams into confident agent builders.

- Being the voice of the customer. Feed what you learn back to me, product, and engineering. Push hard for what our customers need.

- Automate your own role with Dataleap. We build AI employees for a living, and you'll live in the product you're helping customers adopt. Build agents that eliminate the manual parts of your own job instead of doing them by hand.

Who you are 

- Hungry and proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and you're already on it.

- Great with people. You're warm, confident, and easy to trust. You can walk into a room of people you've never met and have them rooting for you by the end.

- Someone customers fall for. The bar is simple: I want customers coming back to me saying "I love this person, what a great hire." You make people feel understood and supported.

- Super AI-native. You breathe AI. You build agents for everything and you're already living in these tools, not just exploring them.

- A culture carrier. You embody how we work and represent Dataleap brilliantly out in the world.

- High agency, low ego. There's unsexy work and you'll do it without flinching. You want to work hard and be part of something ambitious.

- You speak German at a native level and are fluent in English. Based in Munich or ready to move here.

How we work 
This is your life's work right now, and mine too. We operate like athletes: we take care of ourselves and our bodies, and we work hard and win. High standards, high output, no excuses, and we enjoy the ride together.

What this is not 

- Not a coffee-and-shadowing internship, you'll own real customer relationships from week one.

- Direct work with me and exposure to our network at YC, Founders Inc, and CDTM.

- A real path to full-time: grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap as we scale.

- Unlimited AI budget. We practice what we preach.

- Frequent proof that your work matters, straight from the customers you win over.

- Get to know me (Sacha).

- Meet the team.

- A take-home on a real problem we're facing.

- Offer, and you're in.

title: AI Video Creator & Editor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Video Creator & Editor based in Germany. 

This role combines AI video generation and hands-on editing to create high-performing direct-response advertising for Meta and TikTok.
You will own creatives end to end, from interpreting briefs and generating AI footage to editing polished, launch-ready ads.
The position focuses on UGC-style talking-head content, product scenes, b-roll, hooks, variations, and conversion-driven storytelling.
You will work closely with Creative Strategists and the Paid Social team to turn concepts and performance insights into compelling new assets.
Success means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brief creatives at volume while keeping revisions low and continuously improving what performs.
You will join a growing remote video team and have access to AI tools, established workflows, and real campaign environments in which to develop your skills.
The role is fully remote, full-time, and follows UK working hours.

Accountabilities 

- Generate AI video assets for Meta and TikTok advertising, including UGC-style talking-head clips, product scenes, b-roll, and complete concept videos.

- Develop and refine prompts, reference images, and generation settings while maintaining a reusable library of effective prompts and workflows.

- Edit high-volume direct-response ads by combining AI-generated footage with scripts, raw footage, UGC, and approved product assets.

- Create compelling first-second hooks, rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, product demonstrations, offers, and clear calls to action.

- Produce multiple variations of successful concepts by testing different hooks, scenes, characters, openings, pacing, and visual treatments.

- Maintain visual consistency across characters, products, and brand assets while quality-checking generated content for realistic motion, readable text, accurate product representation, and other AI-generation issues.

- Add motion graphics using After Effects or an equivalent tool and ensure creatives meet platform and brand requirements.

- Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists to execute briefs accurately, respond quickly to feedback, and contribute new angles, hooks, and formats suited to AI generation.

- Keep project files, assets, and feedback organized using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar collaboration and asset-management tools.

- Stay current with evolving AI video models and creative technologies, testing new tools and incorporating effective workflows into production.

- Maintain reliable turnaround times and a high-quality output while contributing to creative testing, learning, and scalable advertising concepts.

Requirements:

- Bring 1–3 years of experience in creative or video production, including e-commerce or direct-response paid-social editing, with a portfolio demonstrating both self-edited conversion-focused ads and AI-generated video work.

- Have hands-on experience with AI video-generation tools such as Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Sora, Runway, or similar platforms, with strong prompting and iteration skills.

- Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut, together with After Effects or equivalent motion-graphics capabilities.

- Be comfortable using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar tools for organized asset management, collaboration, and feedback.

- Understand hook-first, direct-response editing for Meta and TikTok, including rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, visual proof, product demonstrations, offers, CTAs, and testable creative variations.

- Have a strong visual eye and the ability to distinguish AI-generated footage that feels authentic from content that appears artificial or unrealistic.

- Be able to maintain high output without sacrificing quality, respond quickly to feedback, and work accurately under pressure.

- Demonstrate creativity, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and a thoughtful, methodical approach to production.

- Have strong written and spoken English, proactive communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a remote creative team.

- Be available for a full-time, exclusive commitment without other clients or freelance work alongside the role.

- Experience with AI image-generation tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux, AI voice tools such as ElevenLabs, winning or scaled advertising campaigns, visually driven DTC categories, motion design, compositing, 3D, VFX, or sound design is considered a plus.

Benefits:

- Competitive compensation discussed individually based on experience and location.

- Fully remote, full-time work following UK working hours.

- Access to AI video-generation tools and approved creative workflows.

- Opportunities to develop AI generation and video-editing skills through real advertising campaigns.

- Regular structured meetings and scheduled feedback sessions with the creative team.

- The opportunity to join a new ten-person video team operating in a high-volume creative testing environment.

- Room for professional growth as AI models, creative workflows, and production capabilities continue to evolve.

title: Move to New Zealand - Technical Strategist (Solution Architect)
description:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company. 

We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). 

Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country. 

Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details). 

The Role: 

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.

Skills & Experience Required: 

- 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications. 

- Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.

- A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.

- Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages.

- Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders. 

- Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.

- Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.

- Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.

- We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.

Responsibilities: 

- Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.

- Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision.

- Building trusted relationships with key client decision-makers. You will be responsible for ensuring our teams understand technical requirements and for clearly explaining our solution design to client technologists.

- You will be the go-to technical person for our client’s solutions, including facilitating any technical pre-requisites for delivery or addressing improvements from operational feedback.

- Developing strategies to ensure quality measures such as speed-to-value, security, reliability, maintainability, performance and functional fit for purpose.

- Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation.

About Propellerhead: 

Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

How We Build Software: 

We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

Benefits: 

- 
Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.

- 
Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.

- 
Opportunity for professional growth and development.

- 
Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

- 
Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

- 
This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).

- 
Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

Cover Letter: 

*Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed. 

It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.

At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients. 

In recruitment, however, AI isn’t used to assess skills, experience or suitability for a role. Every application is reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair, engaged and thoughtfully human process. 

Therefore we kindly ask that you refrain from using it in your application. We're excited to learn about your unique experiences and ideas, so please apply as your authentic self!

description:
In a nutshell 

As a Maintenance Supervisor (m/f/d), you will work in our new Fulfilment Center in the Berlin/Brandenburg area (Falkensee), working with highly automated intralogistics systems from leading brands such as Apollo, Qimarox and Regal Rexnord. You will take operational responsibility for maintenance during your shift and lead our team of Maintenance Technicians.

You set priorities, ensure safe and structured ways of working and act as the key link between Maintenance and Operations. When critical breakdowns occur, you take the lead and work with your team to get our systems back up and running quickly.

Your leadership skills, technical understanding and hands-on mindset will help us keep our operation running smoothly and ensure that around 10,000 orders reach our customers on time every day.

What you’ll do 

- Lead & develop your team: You lead the Maintenance Technicians during your shift, coach them on the job and support their development.

- Own the shift: You set priorities, coordinate maintenance activities and ensure high-quality work and equipment availability.

- Manage critical breakdowns: You coordinate your team during technical issues and work closely with Operations to minimize downtime.

- Drive safety & structure: You ensure that safety standards are followed and that maintenance work is carried out in a clean and structured environment.

- Drive continuous improvement: You identify improvement opportunities and implement Lean, 5S and Continuous Improvement initiatives together with your team.

- Collaborate across teams: You work closely with Operations, Maintenance Engineers and external maintenance partners.

- Competitive salary with growth potential: Starting at €70,000 gross/year, with annual performance reviews designed to drive your personal and financial development.

What you bring 

- You have a completed technical qualification with further training as a Technician or Master Craftsman, or a completed technical degree (Bachelor/Master), for example in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

- You have 10+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance environment, ideally within an automated, logistics or production environment

- You have at least 3 years of leadership experience, for example as a Team Lead, Lead Technician, Supervisor or in a comparable role

- You have a hands-on mindset and understand both the technical and operational side of maintenance

- You have experience with Lean, 5S and Continuous Improvement and enjoy applying these principles on the shop floor

- You work in a structured way, take ownership and stay calm and focused during critical breakdowns

- You are fluent in both English (German is strong plus)

What you can look forward to 

- Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.

- Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.

- Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.

- Masterabschluss (MSc) in Supply Chain Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren technischen bzw. analytischen Studiengang/Abschluss

- 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung mit Schwerpunkt auf Instandhaltung, operativer Strategie, Continuous Improvement oder Prozessengineering

- Starkes Interesse an Automatisierung, Robotik und technischen Instandhaltungssystemen

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Lean, Six Sigma oder Kaizen - idealerweise in einem automatisierten high-volume Umfeld

- Strategische Denkweise sowie die Fähigkeit, bereichsübergreifend Einfluss zu nehmen und größere Initiativen voranzutreiben

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Kooperationsfähigkeit sowie Freude daran, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen

- Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus

Falkensee will be one of the first sites where we build our internal maintenance function for automated equipment. As Maintenance Operations & Continuous Improvement Manager (m/f/d), you will take strategic ownership of the performance and continuous development of our material handling equipment and maintenance processes on site.

You will act as the key interface between the automated and manual processes within the Fulfilment Center, the operational teams, your Maintenance team, our Engineering and Analytics teams, and external partners. You will translate overarching site goals into concrete improvement initiatives, use data to identify optimization opportunities, and ensure that equipment availability, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement remain at a high level in the long term.

What you’ll do 

- Hands-on leadership: Lead the Maintenance value stream day-by-day, coaching Maintenance Engineers and Supervisors to effectively lead their teams and ensuring equipment availability targets are met with indirect leadership.

- Strategic Value Stream Ownership: Define and execute the long-term performance roadmap, taking full ownership of structural strategy and high-level KPIs across safety, quality, throughput, and operational efficiency.

- Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence: Lead site-wide Kaizen initiatives, Lean methodologies, and root-cause analyses to drive structural process enhancements and embed a culture of continuous improvement.

- Data-Driven Process & Automation Optimization: Analyze complex operational and maintenance workflows using data to eliminate bottlenecks, boost system reliability, and improve equipment availability alongside technical teams.

- Cross-Functional Strategic Alignment: Act as the strategic bridge between maintenance, our suppliers, planning, analysts, and operations to ensure seamless, end-to-end operational flow.

- Operational Standards & Governance: Oversee site-wide adherence to safety standards, 5S principles, and operational best practices without getting bogged down in daily engineering management.

What you bring 

- Master’s degree (MSc) in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical field

- 5+ years of experience focused on maintenance, operational strategy, continuous improvement, or process engineering

- Strong interest in, or exposure to, automation, robotics, and facility maintenance systems

- Proven track record in applying Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen frameworks in high-volume, automated environments

- High analytical proficiency, with strong capability in data analysis tools (e.g., Tableau, Excel, SQL)

- Strategic mindset with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive high-level initiatives

- Fluency in English (German is a strong plus)

- Führung & Coaching: Durch Mentoring, Trainings zu Leadership, Feedback und Motivation lernst du, wie du Menschen entwickelst, Klarheit schaffst und herausfordernde Situationen meisterst.

- Eigene Projekte mit Impact: Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale im operativen Alltag und setzt an deinen 1-2 Projekttagen eigenständig Verbesserungsprojekte um, die Produktivität steigern, Prozesse vereinfachen und Engpässe nachhaltig lösen.

Jahr 2: Führung mit Wirkung über Standorte hinweg als Operations Manager

- (Inter)nationale Perspektive : Ergreife die Chance und bring dein Wissen an anderen Picnic Standorten - national oder international - oder lerne eine andere Abteilung entlang unserer Supply Chain kennen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung in einem neuen Umfeld mit neuen Teams und wächst über dich hinaus.

- Fokus auf Projekte: Neben deinen ca. 1-2 Schichttagen pro Woche arbeitest du an ca. 3-4 Tagen an standortübergreifenden Initiativen, z.B. bei der Optimierung unserer Bestellprozesse oder bei der Unterstützung neuer (automatisierter) FCs. Mit deinem operativen Know-How und deinem analytischen Blick hebst du unsere Supply Chain auf das nächste Level.

- Dein nächster Schritt: Nach dem Fast Track stehen dir viele Türen offen: als erfahrener Operations Manager oder in weiteren Positionen innerhalb von Picnic.

Das bringst du mit 

- Du hast dein Masterstudium in Logistik, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Masterstudiengang vor Kurzem erfolgreich beendet oder stehst maximal 6 Monate vor dem Abschluss.

- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Supply-Chain-Umfeld (z.B. durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten) 

- Fließende Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

- Freude daran, als Trainee direkt Verantwortung für ein Team zu übernehmen und Menschen zu motivieren und entwickeln

- Du setzt Ideen mit deiner Hands-on-Mentalität in erfolgreiche Projekte um und gehst als Vorbild voran

- Ein starkes Zahlenverständnis und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen

- Flexibilität und Begeisterung für eine Rolle, die sowohl im Büro als auch im operativen Lagerumfeld stattfindet, inklusive Schichtarbeit

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
What do we do? 

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

The role: 

Paddle's FP&A team is at an exciting inflection point. We've built the foundations of our planning infrastructure, and are looking to scale our impact across the business.

As a Sr. FP&A Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between financial insight and commercial execution, reporting into the Director of FP&A. You'll partner with business leaders to translate Paddle's complex transaction-based business model into clear strategic recommendations that drive profitable growth and investment efficiency, becoming the interface between finance and the business.

This role offers the perfect blend of commercial influence and hands-on impact, with opportunities to shape major business decisions while building the next evolution of FP&A capability at Paddle.

What you'll do: 

- Commercial Finance & Business Partnering 

- Build financial partnerships with key stakeholders across the business (e.g. GTM, Operations), becoming a trusted advisor to senior leaders on resource allocation, commercial strategy and investment optimisation for Marketing and Product decisions.

- Drive insights from Paddle's key metrics (GMV, take rate, CAC, LTV, NRR, churn) into actionable recommendations that influence business direction.

- Leverage finance insights to inform finance and business leadership of important risks and opportunities.

- Support business case development for strategic initiatives such as pricing strategy, market/ product expansion and or new launches.

- Partner with the Director of FP&A and the VP of Finance to support board-level reporting and strategic narratives.

- Forecasting & Analysis 

- Support the evolution of Paddle’s planning models to bridge financial targets with operational execution, enabling our leadership team to translate cross functional insights into faster and better-informed strategic decisions.

- Build and deliver management reporting and dashboards that cut through complexity—ensuring finance insights and recommendations are timely, focused, and decision-oriented.

- Develop deep expertise in Paddle's transaction-based revenue model, bringing visibility to performance across customer segments, geographies, and products.

- Identify opportunities to optimize unit economics and improve capital efficiency across the business.

- Team Development 

- Bring fresh perspectives to our KPI framework and support the team in building commercial fluency.

- Contribute to building a high-performing, high-EQ FP&A culture that values clarity, ownership, and collaboration. We strive for a high-impact, low-ego culture.

- Represent FP&A in cross-functional projects, championing data-driven decision-making across the organization.

We'd love to hear from you if you: 

- Commercially astute and strategically minded - you can connect financial data to business outcomes, and you're energized by influencing commercial strategy, not just reporting on it.

- An exceptional business partner - established in stakeholder management, you can translate complex financial concepts into simple, compelling narratives for non-finance audiences and build trusted relationships with senior leaders.

- Technically strong in FP&A fundamentals - proficient in financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario planning, ideally with experience in SaaS, payments, or transaction-based business models.

- Comfortable with complexity and ambiguity - you thrive in fast-paced scale-up environments where you're flying the plane whilst building it, navigating data quality challenges and evolving tooling (we're re-implementing Pigment).

- Looking to develop the way the team and Paddle operates… and develop yourself too in the process. You enjoy mentoring others and building capability across the team.

- Detail-oriented with strong executive presence - you balance precision and accuracy with the ability to zoom out and present confidently to C-level stakeholders.

- Someone who does what they say, to a very high standard, consistently - you believe that this is how long term trust is built with the business.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle 

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. 

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Our Values 

- Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” 

- Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” 

- Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle 

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Compensation: CA$129,600 – CA$146,538

title: Head of Data Science
description:
What do we do? 

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

The role: 

We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production.

The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics.

We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start.

This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance.

What you'll do: 

- Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly.

- Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build.

- Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them.

- Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way.

- Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on.

- Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions need backdated reconstruction; eval harnesses and trace observability for agentic workflows; and monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance and economic outcomes. Start ad hoc where that's sufficient and platformise once the first use cases have shown what's actually needed.

- Own value capture end to end. Shadow-test and A/B test every deployment against the incumbent strategy, translate metric movement into a financial number on a methodology co-signed by Finance, and publish a quarterly report on realised value.

- Set the governance model for automated decisioning — proportionate risk assessment, clear ownership, latency and availability requirements, human escalation and rollback — working with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Risk on GDPR, EU AI Act and payments obligations, and producing the evidence early enough to shape the design.

- Define the boundaries and the working relationship with Product Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform and AI Enablement, so accountability for decision support versus automated decisioning stays unambiguous.

- Deliver cross-functionally: embed in delivery groups with product owners, domain experts and platform engineers rather than handing models over the wall.

We'd love to hear from you if you: 

- Experienced leading data science or ML teams that own systems in production, with deployments that moved a commercial metric and kept running afterwards. Proofs of concept and dashboards are not what we're hiring for.

- Hands-on now, not formerly. Your first quarters are spent writing SQL and Python, engineering features, evaluating models and agents, and doing the work that gets a system live — not reviewing someone else's.

- Experienced across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and clear about how they differ in practice: propensity and uplift models, feature pipelines and drift on one side; tool and context design, prompt and retrieval iteration, evals against golden answer sets and trace observability on the other.

- Practised at running live systems rather than just launching them — monitoring, retraining, incident response, rollback, and the on-call reality of a decision the business depends on.

- Pragmatic about method: happy to argue for rules or heuristics where they capture most of the value, and to reserve models and agents for where they genuinely earn their keep.

- Comfortable with an undefined starting point. There's a long list of candidate use cases and a strong internal hypothesis, but no fixed roadmap — you'll be expected to form your own view, back it with numbers, and defend it to an executive audience.

- Strong on measurement — experimentation, uplift modelling, back-testing — and willing to hold your own work to a financial number that Finance will scrutinise.

- Fluent in the engineering side of production ML and agents (training pipelines, model registries, inference services, feature stores, drift detection, trace observability) and able to hold your own with senior engineers on latency, availability, observability and rollback.

- Able to hire, level and develop senior data scientists and ML engineers, and to set standards for a function that doesn't exist yet.

- Credible with executives and commercial stakeholders: you can take a use case from business problem to value estimate to prioritisation decision, and say no to low-value work.

- Experienced in payments, fintech, subscriptions, high-volume commercial operations or another regulated transactional domain — enough to get to a credible value estimate in a new area quickly.

- Comfortable treating regulated ML as a design constraint rather than paperwork — model risk assessment, DPIAs, auditability, traceability of model and policy versions to production decision logic.
