As an Applied AI Strategist for EMEA, you will be Anthropic's senior strategic voice with EMEA’s most strategic customers. You'll engage C-suite executives and senior business leaders at Europe's and the Middle East's largest enterprises to understand their challenges, shape their vision for how AI transforms their strategy, and build alignment toward bold, high-impact AI adoption.

This is not a hands-on engineering role. Your job is to walk into a boardroom in cities like London, Paris, Frankfurt or Milan, quickly read the competitive landscape, regulatory context and organizational dynamics, and help leaders see a compelling future centered on Claude. You'll lead our Executive Briefings (EBCs), own strategic positioning and proposals for top-tier EMEA accounts, and build the content, value frameworks and templates that let the wider team operate credibly at the executive level.

You'll bring deep enterprise technology experience and a track record at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution in European markets. Responsibilities 

- Lead Executive Briefings (EBCs) for Anthropic's most strategic EMEA accounts, reframing how C-suite leaders think about AI and adapting narrative, tone and proof points to each market and culture.

- Own strategic positioning for top-tier customers: executive narratives, value cases, strategic proposals and success plans, built with Sales and Applied AI.

- Create content that enables the team in executive-facing engagements: industry points of view for our core sectors (financial services, insurance, telco, manufacturing and automotive, life sciences, energy, public sector, retail and luxury), value frameworks, and templates for strategic proposals and success plans.

- Turn the European regulatory landscape (EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA, EU AML regulations, data residency and sovereignty) from a perceived blocker into part of the case for Claude.

- Partner with Sales and Applied AI before and after engagements to align, debrief and carry the vision through to execution; stay close to high-momentum accounts as a trusted advisor and sustain deal momentum.

- Travel regularly across EMEA for executive engagements, workshops and strategic account meetings.

- 15+ years in enterprise technology or management consulting, with significant time at executive level in core EMEA markets (UK&I, France, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, Southern Europe, Middle East and Africa).

- A track record of influencing C-suite leaders at large European enterprises, and the cultural range to do it differently in Paris, Munich and Milan.

- Deep understanding of how large, often regulated, organizations evaluate, adopt and scale technology.

- The ability to connect AI capabilities to strategic outcomes through clear value frameworks and business cases.

- Experience producing executive-grade content others reuse: industry perspectives, strategic proposals, success plans.

- Strong opinions about what makes enterprise transformation succeed or fail, earned by leading or advising these efforts.

- Comfort with ambiguity and pace in a fast-moving market.

- A collaborative mindset: sales at Anthropic is a team sport. English plus another major European language is a strong plus.

- Travel will be more than 50% of your time with this role covering EMEA 

- Excitement about AI's potential to transform how enterprises operate, and a real desire to help customers succeed with it.

Annual Salary:

£230,000 — £270,000 GBP 

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different 

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Bristol, United Kingdom
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API

- Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break

- Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on

- Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

- Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat

- Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

- Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)

- Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud

- A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created

- A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone

- The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it

- Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it

- A preference for being corrected over being right

- Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments

- Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process 

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer 

- A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

- A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

- Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

- The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

- Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

- The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

- An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Think you’re a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. 
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them! 

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com .

THE ROLE 

As Associate Director, Media Planning, you’ll lead the development of strategic media plans and RFP/RFI responses, partnering closely with sales and cross-functional teams to deliver thoughtful, KPI-driven proposals. This role will be part of the EMEA Activation team, supporting the UK based programmatic sales organisation. 

This role is designed for an experienced media planner who can translate client goals into clear, actionable recommendations and communicate confidently with internal stakeholders. You’ll play a meaningful role in driving revenue and shaping how we approach planning at a fast-growing digital advertising technology company. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

- Lead the development of strategic media plans and proposals that support new business and account growth 

- Own the end-to-end planning process for RFPs and proactive proposals, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and on-time delivery 

- Present media strategies and recommendations to sales teams and internal stakeholders; manage updates as campaign details evolve 

- Guide campaign design across channels including display, video, social, email, streaming audio, CTV and DOOH 

- Translate campaign goals into specific audience, inventory, and targeting recommendations using internal and third-party data 

- Act as a subject-matter expert on products, solutions, and media capabilities for sales and internal partners 

- Collaborate closely with sales, analytics, partnerships, supply and other teams to ensure alignment on goals, timelines, and deliverables 

- Capture and share market and client feedback to inform planning approaches and product improvements 

- Help build and maintain proposal templates, reference materials, and best practices 

- Continuously improve proposal quality, workflows, and planning processes to increase efficiency and consistency 

WHO YOU ARE 

- An experienced digital media planner who is comfortable making strategic recommendations tied to KPIs, budgets, and timelines 

- Highly detail-oriented and accountable, with the ability to manage work independently and meet tight deadlines 

- A clear, proactive communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and informed 

- Collaborative by nature and comfortable working cross-functionally with sales, analytics, strategy, and product teams 

- Confident presenting ideas and recommendations and partnering closely with sales throughout the planning process 

- Adaptable and comfortable navigating changing requirements without sacrificing quality 

- Organised and effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment 

- Curious about advertising trends and motivated by using data and insights to drive better outcomes 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED 

- Minimum 5 years of experience in digital media planning, strategy, or online advertising 

- Strong understanding of digital ad metrics, FX rates, benchmarks, analysis, and pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPA) 

- Experience planning across multiple advertising categories and using data to inform recommendations 

- Advanced working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint 

- Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment 

Benefits and Perks: 

- Excellent medical, dental and vision coverage

You will own complex, client-facing projects from planning through execution, bringing structure, clarity and momentum across Delivery, Data Science, Product, Engineering, GTM and customer teams.

This role is suited to an experienced Project Manager who is already comfortable operating independently, but who also values coaching, feedback and continuous development. You will be expected to anticipate issues before they escalate, challenge ambiguity, improve how we work and bring practical ideas that strengthen delivery.

What You’ll Do 

- Own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software projects across the UK portfolio

- Build and maintain credible delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID registers, decision logs and governance rhythms

- Connect Shift’s Delivery, Data Science, Product, Engineering and GTM teams with the customer’s technical and business stakeholders

- Anticipate delivery, resource, commercial and customer risks early, then bring clear options and recommendations

- Manage several workstreams or clients at the same time without losing control of detail, priorities or customer outcomes

- Improve delivery practices through reusable templates, smarter workflows, automation and practical use of AI

- Contribute to strategic UK and wider Delivery initiatives that make execution more predictable, repeatable and scalable

What You Bring 

- 7+ years delivering enterprise SaaS and complex IT delivery: At least 7 years of experience delivering IT, enterprise SaaS, data, analytics, or digital transformation projects, with a strong background in complex client-facing implementations.

- Independent cross-functional operator: The ability to operate independently across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams, making sound judgments while knowing when to escalate appropriately.

- Modern tooling proficiency: Experience using core delivery platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, Atlassian, Asana, Monday.com, or similar PMO systems.

- Language skills: Native or full professional fluency in English.

- Industry experience: Prior experience in insurance is strongly preferred; background in fraud, data science, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

- Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or similar project management certifications are advantageous, though not essential.

title: Senior Scrum Master - Core Video & Data
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces . 

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.

As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:

- Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.

- Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.

- Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.

- Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.

- Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.

Location 

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

- An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.

- A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.

- Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.

- A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.

- A champion of responsible speed. You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.

Nice-to-Haves

- AI fluency. You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.

- A diverse Agile toolbelt. You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.

- Global team experience. Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Our Role

- Champion work-life harmony . We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. 

- Guarantee autonomy . We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas. 

- Encourage career growth . We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing. 

- Provide an environment to help you succeed . We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work. 

- Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below— starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range. 

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. 

Base Salary Range

£48,000 — £80,000 GBP 

Inclusion at Hudl

title: Senior Product Designer - CRO, London, UK
description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

- Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets

- Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS

- Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

People arrive at our pages ready to change their health, and unsure whether to begin. Starting a treatment that could change your life is a big decision, and often a frightening one. Your job is to help them take the first step.

This is a Senior Product Designer role for someone who can make that moment clear, credible and human. You design the surfaces where people decide to start, some of the highest-stakes creative work we have, and you can measure your impact in the number of people who begin.

In this role, you will: 

- Design every page as an argument. Every element earns its place: the problem, the solution, the proof, the process, the value, and the blockers you remove.

- Own our highest-leverage acquisition surfaces end to end: landing pages, the signature conversion components on them, and the templates they sit in.

- Own the conversion-bearing pieces others don't, e.g. BMI calculators and the interstitial moments that carry someone through a clinical quiz and consult form, the points where people hesitate and leave.

- Make the case on every surface. Meet someone where they are in their decision and build a clear, structured argument for why to start, built around them, not a list of features.

- Translate clinical language into words a patient understands and trusts. Accurate, compliant and human at once.

- Design dense information like an infographic: communicate a lot, simply. Data visualisation and strong hierarchy in place of walls of text, without losing the detail. Our patients care about the detail, so your job is to convey it clearly, not to oversimplify.

- Lean on interaction design to carry the detail. Progressive disclosure, reveals and interactive data let people go as deep as they want, without meeting it all at once.

- Use motion and pacing with intent. You control the rhythm of a page and the beat between steps, so people keep moving.

- Carry the creative set from our adverts through to the landing page and the touchpoints after it. One unbroken story from ad to conversion.

- Partner your CRO manager on the optimisation loop. You bring the hypothesis and the design, shape the tests and read what comes back, and turn the result into the next move.

- Help more people start. That is the number you move, and you always know why it moved.

- Earn trust with evidence: multiple, specific proof points, not a logo and a star rating, all holding up in a regulated market.

What good looks like 

- Scope: you own the front door. The acquisition surfaces where people decide whether to begin, and the design-led testing that keeps them improving.

- Impact: you help more people get started. At our scale that reaches into millions of lives, real people beginning a treatment that changes theirs. You move that number, and you can show the before and after.

- Influence: you work alongside growth experts, CROs, and product and commercial partners. You hold the bar on what is right for the patient, balancing it against the needs of the business. You bring people with you by offering options and choices, gaining buy-in with evidence rather than force. And you raise the bar inside the design team too, giving sharp critique and making the designers around you better.

About you (who you are) 

The best person for this role has a rare mix. You make dense, complex medical information simple and clear, without dumbing it down or losing what matters. You are doing this for people at a vulnerable moment, so empathy and emotional intelligence are critical. You read the emotion in a health decision and meet people where they are, with warmth and without judgement. And you are deeply curious about health. You do not need to arrive knowing the conditions we treat, only the drive to understand them. You pair all of that with sharp acquisition craft and the discipline to test. You hold the human and the commercial in the same hand.

Skills & experience 

- Problem definition. You shape the problem, not just the pixels. You use data and research to work out which surface matters most and which experiment is worth running, then package it into something the team can build. The signal is evidence you helped define the right test, not just made the variant.

- Visual craft. Non-negotiable. Typography, spacing, colour, motion and micro-interactions, used with intent, not decoration. This role also carries the interstitial illustration in the quiz and consult flow, so you make that visual work yourself. Weak craft is a no, whatever the conversion talk.

- Accessibility. You design inclusively without being asked. You know why the standard exists, not just what it says, and it shows in judgement calls a checklist cannot make.

- Systems thinking. You think in modules, not single pages. You compose from the design system's primitives, own the signature, conversion-bearing components built on top, and build page templates that assemble in different ways to serve different needs. Modularity is your default and it keeps you fast, but you build bespoke, ground-up pages when a high-profile moment deserves the craft. You extend the system rather than reinvent it, and you keep a clean line between the atomic layer the system owns and the bespoke pieces you own. Infrastructure compounds. Single screens do not.

- Product and commercial sense. You reason in conversion rate, cost per acquisition and funnel drop-off. You know which page matters most to the business and why, and you defend a design decision in the language of the metric it moves. Craft in isolation moves nothing.

- Communication. Clear, specific, opinionated. You say what you decided and why, and you are just as clear on what you chose not to do and why.

- Working in the open. You share early and often, and you use critique to sharpen the work. You lift the quality of every review you join.

How you work with AI 

- LLMs are already embedded in your workflow. You use them to widen the range of variants you can test and to tighten the build-measure-learn loop.

- You prototype in tools like Claude Code and Cursor to test ideas in real code, not just mock them up.

- The signal is workflow, not tool count. Judgement spent where it counts.

The full stack 

- We expect you to work end to end, from problem definition and research to information architecture and UX writing.

- Validation and experimentation is the core of the role. You design A/B tests, size them, and read them honestly.

- Your own research and usability testing, feeding the next experiment.

- Copywriting and UX writing. You write the words that persuade and the words that guide, and both hold up in a regulated market.

- Composition from the design system, and ownership of the signature components and templates built on top of it.

Your portfolio 

Show us work where you took something complex and made it land. A page that told a clear story, held the detail without overwhelming, and helped a real person make a decision. We want the craft on the surface, the words weighted as heavily as the graphics, and evidence you designed with empathy for people at a moment that mattered. Show the outcome too: the number you moved and the testing that got you there. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Experience 

Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of conversion-focused design and A/B testing on acquisition surfaces. 

Behaviours & attitude 

- Patient-first mindset. You put patient outcomes first. Every decision weighs commercial growth against clinical safety and care, and you don't let one erode the other. You understand real health journeys well enough to make them simple, accessible and worth trusting.

- Collaborative creation. You work well across product, engineering and clinical, and you know a good idea can come from any of them. You listen to feedback and take it on, using it to make the work better.

- Curiosity. You ask why before how. You stay curious about the patient, the problem and the tools you use to solve it, and you're comfortable being a beginner when something new is worth learning.
Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of conversion-focused design and A/B testing on acquisition surfaces.

Why join Eucalyptus? 

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics ( Pilot, Kin , Software ) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique: 

- What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

- Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

- Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

- Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

- Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the UK

- Be an owner – Your own stake in the business with our employee options program

- Invest in your growth – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave

- Work flexibly – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration

- Support your well-being – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you

- Take time off – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year

- Join a connected team – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, and Threat Detection & Response.

Product Security (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Identity (this role!) is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

Threat Detection & Response focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We're proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As the Head of Product and Identity Security, you'll own two of those three areas, reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and operating as a peer to the Head of Threat Detection & Response. The remit spans application security, penetration testing, cloud security, artificial intelligence (AI) security, secure architecture, identity, and vulnerability operations. You'll lead a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India, and you'll stay close to the technology: this is a player-manager role, where credibility is earned by doing the work as well as directing it. This is a real opportunity to make an impact and have senior influence on the cyber resilience strategy at Tide.

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

As a Head of Product and Identity Security you will: 

- Defining the product and identity security strategy in conjunction with the CISO and operationalising it into a funded, sequenced roadmap that the team can execute against.

- Leading, coaching, and growing a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India; setting clear objectives; running regular 1:1s; and supporting career growth and progression.

- Owning application security end-to-end, from secure design reviews and threat modelling through to secure coding standards, tooling, and remediation of findings.

The CAM will be responsible for quoting, training, lead generation and follow-up, event support, and the forecasting and tracking for their assigned partners. The CAM will report to the Country Manager, working closely to assure territory quota attainment, in addition to joining with the sales and field marketing teams in the territory. · Maintain regular contact with partners to ensure satisfaction and continued success

· Partner with Territory Channel Account Manager to generate new business and develop current customers through the partner network

· Support partners on standard methodologies and use of WatchGuard, including training, event support, and lead generation

· Create and perform sales presentations to match WatchGuard with audience needs

· Provide ongoing relationship management and training for partners

· Experience with two-tier/channel sales ecosystem required

· Experience in network/cyber security space preferred

· History of sales experience with partner accounts

title: Solution Innovation Analyst
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning 

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. 

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. 

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. 

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the Role 

As a Solution Innovation Analyst, you will be the operational backbone of the Solution Innovation Center. You will support Account Executives and the wider GTM organisation with the day-to-day mechanics of getting RFPs, security reviews, and questionnaires completed accurately and on time, and help keep our Consensus demo automation platform and video content pipeline running smoothly. You will work cross-functionally on a regular basis, partnering with teams such as Legal and Security to get responses reviewed and signed off. This is an entry level or early career role within the Solution Innovation Center, based in our Paris office, ideal for someone looking to build a foundation in presales operations and grow into broader Solutions Consulting responsibilities. 

What we offer 

- Competitive package

- Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth

- The best health insurance with Alan Blue, entirely free for you and your family 

- Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility

- Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France

- A Learning Stipend per year, for you to develop into areas that amplify impact for your careers or personal development

- Remote work stipend to have the best work station possible at home

- Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London

- High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

What You'll Do: 

RFP Operational Support 

- 
Intake & Triage – Support the SC team and wider GTM organisation with the operational processes around incoming RFPs, prioritising and routing requests appropriately. 

- 
Document Handling – Manage the upload, formatting, and export of RFP documents, ensuring AEs and SCs have what they need in the right format and on time. 

- 
Platform & User Administration – Administer user access and permissions within Ombud, Pigment's RFP tooling, keeping the platform running smoothly for the wider GTM team and becoming a go-to resource for basic platform questions. 

- 
Status Tracking – Keep RFP trackers and dashboards current so that the GTM Org and leadership always have visibility into RFP performance. 

Infosec Questionnaire Support 

- 
Technical SC Partnership – Work closely with the Technical Solution Consulting team to respond to Infosec questionnaires, coordinating inputs and ensuring responses are submitted accurately and on time. 

- 
Question Routing – Triage incoming Infosec questions, handling standard items directly from the answer library and routing anything technical to the Technical SC team. 

Demo Automation Platform Administration (Consensus) 

- 
User Administration – Manage user access and permissions within Consensus, Pigment's demo automation platform. 

- 
Content Administration – Organise, tag, and maintain content within Consensus so that demo videos and Interactive Product Tours stay current and easy for the field to find. 

Content Creation & Video Editing (Descript) 

- 
Content Support – Support the creation of demo videos and other digital content, using Descript to edit and produce assets for the Video demo library. 

Cross-Functional Coordination 

- 
GTM Partnership – Act as a responsive point of contact for AEs on RFP status, timelines, and next steps. 

- 
Legal & Security Coordination – Work cross-functionally with teams such as Legal and Security to route questions, gather input, and get RFP and Infosec responses reviewed and signed off. 

- 
CSM Coordination – Support Post-Sales teams with the administrative steps of security and infosec review requests, routing them to the right owner. 

Who You Are: 

- 
Experience: Entry level or early career (1-3 years). Some experience in the software industry or operational experience in an industry setting would be an advantage. No prior presales experience required. 

- 
Location & Language: Based in our Paris office, with fluency in English required. 

- 
Organised & Detail-Oriented: Comfortable managing multiple requests at once, with a strong eye for accuracy and consistency in written material. You must be able to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines. 

- 
Process-Minded: Enjoys bringing structure and reliability to operational workflows, and takes ownership of the tasks in front of them. 

- 
Proactive Communicator: Openly communicates status, roadblocks, and concerns with the SIC team and stakeholders across GTM. 

- 
Coachable: Takes ownership of individual learning, asks questions, and seeks support on assigned tasks as they ramp. 

-

title: Aircraft Painter
description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Aircraft Painter to join our aviation maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and painting aircraft surfaces to meet high industry standards. As an Aircraft Painter, you will work on a variety of aircraft types, ensuring the external appearance and protective coating of the aircraft meet both aesthetic and regulatory standards. Your expertise in surface preparation, painting, and finishing will be crucial in ensuring aircraft are ready for operation and maintain their durability in various conditions.

This role is essential for ensuring that aircraft are protected from environmental elements and have a visually appealing and professional finish. If you have an eye for detail and a passion for precision work, this is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the aviation industry.

Key Responsibilities: 
- Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, masking, and sanding areas to remove old paint or contaminants.
- Apply primers, base coats, and topcoats according to industry standards and manufacturer specifications.
- Use spray painting equipment to ensure even and accurate application of paint to aircraft surfaces.
- Follow precise instructions and blueprints to create custom designs, logos, or lettering on aircraft.
- Inspect painted surfaces for quality, ensuring proper thickness, gloss, and uniformity of color.
- Repair and touch up paintwork as necessary, ensuring aircraft meet regulatory and aesthetic standards.
- Maintain and clean painting equipment and tools, ensuring they are in proper working order.
- Comply with safety regulations, using appropriate protective gear and ensuring the workspace is safe and clean.
- Record and document all work performed, including materials used and procedures followed.
- Work with other maintenance team members to ensure the aircraft is ready for delivery on schedule.
- Ensure compliance with environmental regulations regarding the use of chemicals and hazardous materials.
- Assist in the development of painting schedules and timelines, ensuring that projects are completed on time.

Qualifications: 
- Proven experience as an Aircraft Painter or in a related role (e.g., automotive or industrial painting).
- Familiarity with aircraft painting techniques, materials, and procedures.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
- Skilled in the use of spray guns, sanders, buffers, and other painting equipment.
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce high-quality finishes.
- Knowledge of safety protocols related to handling hazardous chemicals and materials.
- Physical stamina and dexterity to work in confined spaces or at heights.
- Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate effectively with other technicians and engineers.
- Excellent time management and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Experience working with a variety of aircraft types (commercial, military, private jets, etc.).
- Familiarity with corrosion prevention and metal treatment processes.
- Knowledge of environmentally safe painting products and techniques.
- Ability to apply complex custom designs, logos, or branding.
- Certification in aircraft painting or a relevant field (preferred but not mandatory depending on experience).
- Knowledge of relevant aviation regulatory standards (such as FAA or EASA guidelines) concerning painting and surface finishing.
- Training in the safe handling of hazardous materials (e.g., OSHA, WHMIS certification).

Day to day, you will: 

- track delivery across teams and releases 

- coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams 

- identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early 

- challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments 

- coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk 

- provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment. 

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective . 

What success looks like 

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery. 

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement. 

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation. 

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability : how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to. 

Who we are looking for 

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership , for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager. 

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams.

- previous hands-on experience as a software engineer

- a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution 

- strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies 

- understanding of Product Management fundamentals 

- experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar 

- strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills 

- professional fluency in English . 

French and Russian are nice to have. 

This role will suit you if… 

You still enjoy technical complexity , but what really motivates you is making execution work. 

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it. 

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered. 

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better. 

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear. 

Why Diabolocom 

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms , powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries . 

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite , backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation.

Why this role

title: Head of Infrastructure
description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications 

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads , while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth .

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different 

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

- Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.

- On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.

- Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.

- Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.

- Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.

- AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.

- Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission 

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will: 

- Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.

- Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.

- Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.

- Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure : topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.

- Own our on-premise infrastructure operations : data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.

- Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure : PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.

- Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure , including GPU workloads and compute clusters.

- Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.

- Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.

- Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for 

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

- a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;

- an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;

- a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;

- a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have 

- Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:

- networking;

- SRE/reliability;

- database administration;

- telecom/voice infrastructure;

- hardware/on-premise infrastructure.

- Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.

- Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).

- Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise.

- Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.

- Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

- Ability to work onsite in Paris.

Nice to Have 

Experience with:

- Telecom or carrier infrastructure.

- Voice platforms or real-time communication systems.

- PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale.

- Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking.

- Kubernetes in production.

- GPU infrastructure.

- Incident command and post-mortem culture.

About You 

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Why join us 

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact. 

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced. 

From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter.

Build something from an early stage of maturity. 

You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth.

Work directly with technical leadership. 

You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes.

Recruitment Process 

- 
Intro call with Talent Acquisition 
Up to 1h — alignment on experience, expectations and motivation.

- 
Two technical conversations with Sergey, CTO 
Focused on:

- infrastructure strategy;

- technical depth;

- architecture decisions;

- operational leadership approach.

- 
Meeting with the infrastructure team 
Onsite or online session focused on collaboration, problem-solving and engineering culture.

- 
Final conversation with CEO

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed
🏠 Relocation support available

One More Thing 

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already done this exact role in this exact environment.

The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities.

If you have built and operated complex infrastructure, enjoy solving ambiguous technical challenges and want to shape a critical engineering domain — we would love to talk.

title: Technical Advisor – Airframe & Engine
description:
About JSSI 

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Chicago, Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) is the largest independent provider of hourly cost maintenance programs for business aviation. JSSI delivers comprehensive coverage for engines, airframes, and auxiliary power units (APUs) across more than 300 different aircraft makes and models, helping owners and operators stabilize maintenance budgets, maximize aircraft availability, and protect asset value throughout the lifecycle of ownership. JSSI has built a portfolio of complementary business lines designed to simplify the economic and technical complexity of business aviation; these include Maintenance teams , Traxxall maintenance tracking software, Parts & Engines , Conklin aircraft cost and performance data, and Aviation Capital asset-based financing solutions. Together, these offerings support owners, operators, and maintenance providers with integrated tools spanning ownership and maintenance planning, execution, and financial management. With more than 6,500 aircraft supported through programs and software platforms, JSSI leverages its unique independence, unmatched scale, and data-driven insight to deliver customized solutions and support models aligned to the interests of each client — regardless of aircraft platform. JSSI is backed by leading institutional investors GTCR, Genstar Capital, and Blackstone. Learn more at jetsupport.com . 

Position Summary 

The Technical Advisor serves as the primary point of contact between the Client and the maintenance organization for both airframe and engine matters, acting as a trusted technical representative throughout the lifecycle of aircraft maintenance events. This role manages and coordinates client needs across routine maintenance, minor unscheduled findings, major scheduled inspections, and Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations — for airframes, engines, and related systems — utilizing Product Line Specialists (PLS) as needed to support events requiring specialized assistance.

As the customer's key technical liaison, the Technical Advisor acts as an advocate for the Client and provides expert guidance to support informed decision-making, balancing airworthiness, operational impact, cost control, and schedule adherence.

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Collaborate with customers to evaluate and recommend the most appropriate inspection and maintenance alternatives for airframe and engine events.

- Set up and support customers in coordinating all aspects of maintenance events — including preliminary scheduled inspections, minor unscheduled findings, and major unscheduled or major scheduled events — with assigned repair facilities and service providers.

- Provide on-site customer representation, particularly during major scheduled inspections.

- Support customers during Aircraft on Ground (AOG) events, ensuring timely communication and resolution.

- Create and manage Service Calls to track technical data, event progress, and support financial forecasting.

- Develop and maintain strong client relationships through regular and proactive communication.

- Build and sustain working relationships with regional service facilities, mobile repair teams, and other service providers.

- Research aircraft logbooks and/or perform visual inspections for new enrollments or existing contract reviews.

- Review and process invoices in AMS, meeting turn-time goals established by Technical Services Management and company policy.

- Perform event triage by assessing maintenance findings and ensuring each situation is handled appropriately and efficiently, serving as primary liaison between maintenance facilities, parts sourcing vendors, and the customer — handling the event directly or turning it over to a Product Line Specialist as needed.

- Conduct asset inspections when enrolling new aircraft into service programs.

- Maintain a thorough working knowledge of applicable contracts, policies, and procedures.

- Perform additional duties as assigned by Technical Services Management.

Desired Credentials: 

- Unrestricted work and residency authorization in the United States required.

- Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) ratings, or equivalent, required.

- Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in an Aviation field preferred.

- 10 years' experience with corporate turbine-powered business aircraft (not commercial) preferred, with particular expertise working with Gulfstream and Bombardier airframes and their associated engine platforms.

- Excellent Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills.

- Strong interpersonal skills.

- Ability to read and write articulately and analytically.

- Clear understanding of relevant technical skills.

- Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure.

- Well organized.

- Have or be able to obtain a passport and perform international travel.

At JSSI, we are committed to rewarding our team members with competitive and comprehensive compensation packages that reflect their contributions and talent. 

For this role, the annual base pay generally ranges from $90,000 to $105,000, with the final offer determined by variable factors including but not limited to market location, job-specific knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition, your total rewards package may include an annual discretionary bonus plan, incentive or sales bonus plan, or other form of additional compensation, based on your role. 

Additionally, for full-time employees based in the USA, Canada, or the Philippines, we are proud to offer a robust suite of benefits. This ranges from insurance offerings such as medical, dental, vision, retirement savings programs, among others, starting day one of employment. For a full overview of our offerings, visit the JSSI Benefits Page on our company website. 

JSSI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristic protected by law. 

JSSI does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team.

title: Distinguished Engineer
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role :

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer based in our Paris office to lead the technical transformations that are too large, too cross-cutting, or too critical to belong to a single engineering team.

This is a company-wide IC role with direct report to the CTO and explicit authority to drive major technical decisions across Product Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure and Data.

This isn't an advisory role, it's a mandate to change how Brevo Engineering works at a foundational level 

What you will do: 
You will own a small number of high-impact technical transformations end to end: architecture, implementation strategy, migration, adoption and retirement of legacy systems.

Examples include:

- rebuilding our CI/CD and deployment architecture across hundreds of services and repositories;

- replacing fragmented logging and observability patterns with an OpenTelemetry-based platform backed by ClickHouse;

- redesigning how we use Kafka and introducing stronger platform abstractions around messaging;

- turning ClickHouse into a first-class internal product rather than a database consumed inconsistently across teams;

- defining and driving common standards around service communication, reliability, runtime architecture and developer platforms.

These initiatives will cross organizational boundaries and require changes to both infrastructure and application code.

Your responsibility is to own the projects end to end, driving them through every stage and resolving whatever obstacles arise until it is delivered.

Who you are: 

- You have already operated at Principal, Distinguished, Senior Principal, Fellow, or equivalent level within a significantly larger engineering organization.

- You have repeatedly led transformations involving

- hundreds of engineers or large service fleets,

- distributed systems and production infrastructure,

- complex migrations where old and new worlds had to coexist,

- strong technical disagreement across senior teams,

- and architecture decisions with broad and lasting consequences.

- You move fluidly between a system design discussion, a code review, a production incident, a migration plan, and an executive-level technical decision.

- You bring deep expertise in several of the following: Kubernetes, CI/CD, Kafka, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, distributed databases, service communication, developer platforms, and large-scale observability.

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Head of GTM Systems & AI

What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?

GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.

We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.

You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.

title: IT Support Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Du hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen, behältst auch bei mehreren offenen Themen den Überblick und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen. 

Bei eHealth-Connect entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen für die vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Produkte werden von unterschiedlichen Akteuren im Gesundheitswesen genutzt – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, wenn Fragen entstehen, Prozesse nicht wie erwartet laufen oder technische Unterstützung benötigt wird.

Dabei geht es bei uns nicht um klassischen Callcenter-Support, sondern darum, Probleme wirklich zu verstehen, strukturiert einzugrenzen und gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Teams Lösungen zu finden.

Warum brauchen wir diese Rolle? 

Mit unseren Produkten, Kunden und Anwendungsfällen wächst auch die Zahl der Themen, die im täglichen Betrieb schnell und zuverlässig gelöst werden müssen. Deshalb möchten wir unseren Support weiter professionalisieren und suchen jemanden, der Supportfälle strukturiert übernimmt, technische Zusammenhänge analysiert und dafür sorgt, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell die richtige Unterstützung bekommen. Gleichzeitig bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu unseren technischen und fachlichen Teams: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, bereitest komplexere Fälle sauber auf und hilfst damit auch uns, unsere Produkte und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Warum ist die Rolle spannend? 

Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F.

Unsere Lösungen bewegen sich in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld und verbinden Software, unterschiedliche Systeme, Schnittstellen und Prozesse im Gesundheitswesen miteinander. Das bedeutet: Hinter einer Supportanfrage steckt manchmal eine einfache Bedienfrage – manchmal aber auch ein technisches Puzzle. Du lernst unsere Produkte und Systeme sehr genau kennen, arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Deployment und Fachbereichen zusammen und entwickelst mit der Zeit ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo ein Problem entsteht und wie wir es am besten lösen können.

Aufgaben

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

- Annahme, Erfassung und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen unserer Kund:innen

- Unterstützung der Anwender:innen bei Fragen zur Bedienung und zu den Prozessen unserer Produkte

- Analyse und erste Eingrenzung technischer und fachlicher Fehler

- Prüfung von Fehlermeldungen, Prozessstatus, Logs und vorhandenen Systeminformationen

- Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Supportfällen sowie Überwachung vereinbarter Service Levels

- Lösung bekannter Störungen anhand vorhandener Dokumentationen und Workarounds

- Qualifizierte Eskalation komplexerer Fälle an 2nd Level, Entwicklung oder zuständige Fachbereiche

- Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Lösungen und wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern in unserer Wissensdatenbank

Qualifikation

Was hilft dir, in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein?

Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast.

- Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil

- Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise

- Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs

- Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management, zum Beispiel nach ITIL v4, sind wünschenswert

- Grundkenntnisse in Webanwendungen, APIs und JSON sind von Vorteil

- Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Uns ist wichtiger, wie du an Probleme herangehst, wie du kommunizierst und ob du Lust hast, dich in unsere Produkte und Technologien einzuarbeiten, als dass du bereits jedes Kästchen erfüllst. Auch der sinnvolle Einsatz von KI im Arbeitsalltag wird bei uns ausdrücklich gefördert und ist bereits Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Über eHealth-Connect

Wir entwickeln Software und digitale Lösungen für eine moderne, vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Technologien verbinden unterschiedliche Akteure und Systeme im Gesundheitswesen und tragen dazu bei, digitale Versorgung einfacher, sicherer und besser nutzbar zu machen.

Dabei arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Softwareentwicklung, Telematikinfrastruktur und neuen digitalen Versorgungskonzepten.

Wir arbeiten hybrid und haben ein modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte, das wir als Ort für Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gemeinsame Teamtage nutzen.

Klingt nach etwas, das zu dir passen könnte?

Dann melde dich bei uns. Ob mit Lebenslauf oder einfach ein paar Sätzen darüber, wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum dich die Rolle interessiert – wir möchten vor allem dich kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

Who we're looking for: 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide.
